additional_info.subject: RE: ID0468698-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003138] Router issue CRM:03288000023
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Chergui,
I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for raising the issue.
The charger is in offline. As you know we can´t proceed any troubleshooting for offline charger. Please ask the customer to turn on the charger. If he is unable to turn on the charger, we need to send technician to do manual troubleshooting.
It is also recommended that the charger use latest version of firmware. It looks it has very old version.
Please ask the client, if he can update the charger. Alternatively we can update remotely, but need his permission to do it.
Normally, we ask some evidence(Photos) to send MLFB for replacement.
But, if you confirm that, I can send MLFB for the replacement.
I wish a happy holiday season to you and your family.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
